cohort: 118 cases of prenatally diagnosed ventriculomegaly examined and treated at the 1st Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, at the Medical University of Warsaw, from August 2007 until November 2017
finding: The study found that isolated ventriculomegaly has significantly better long-term outcomes compared with non-isolated ventriculomegaly.
mod_finding: This study found that the risk of premature delivery and cesarean section are significantly higher in cases of non-isolated ventriculomegaly.
gest_age: 36 + 4 weeks for IVM and 33 + 4 weeks for NIVM
